enrichment.summary: Enforces multi-factor authentication (MFA) and password change for users identified with high-risk sign-ins across all applications and platforms.
enrichment.rationale: This policy helps organisations mitigate potential account compromise by requiring additional authentication steps and a password reset for users flagged with high-risk sign-ins.
enrichment.userImpact: Users with high-risk sign-ins will be prompted to complete MFA and change their password before accessing any applications.
